mission.goal: Transform the repository into an industry-grade, reusable Hospital Information System platform that allows a developer to assemble a production-oriented outpatient and inpatient system quickly.
mission.successDefinition: The repository has a clean build, tested implementation, accurate documentation, tenant isolation, clinical auditability, standards-aware interoperability, safe failure behavior, and independently reviewable evidence for every advertised capability.
explicitNonGoals: No claim of HIPAA or GDPR certification
No autonomous clinical diagnosis or prescribing
No standards certification without independent conformance testing
No external integration claim without a working integration test

orderOfWork: Update documentation only after implementation and tests prove the claim
forbiddenShortcuts: Generating random IDs for resources that were not stored
Using isAuthenticated as a substitute for patient authorization
Treating regex redaction as guaranteed Safe Harbor compliance
Treating a draft in process memory as an immutable attestation ledger
Empty allergy or medication context for order safety checks
Mock STOW-RS success for metadata-only storage
Marketing demo integrations as production integrations

targetArchitecture.migrationOwner: Choose one authoritative migration system and separate from the alternative system
dataStores: Optional Kafka or RabbitMQ event transport
Object storage for approved media and documents
standards: X12 where a payer requires it

currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.finding: Patient-data endpoints use authentication as an alternative to required patient or clinical permissions.
currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.requiredFix: Remove broad authenticated-user alternatives on patient APIs. Require explicit permission and contextual authorization.
acceptanceTests: Authorized clinician receives expected patient data
Break-the-glass is evaluated and audited separately

currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.finding: Some bulk and patient search paths use findAll or do not visibly constrain facility identity.
currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.requiredFix: Enforce facility scoping in repository queries and service authorization. Activate PostgreSQL RLS or equivalent database isolation.
acceptanceTests: Bulk export never returns another tenant's patients
IHE search cannot cross tenant boundaries
Direct repository lookup rejects cross-tenant entities
Database session facility context is set and cleared correctly
RLS policy denies cross-facility data access

currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.finding: FHIR Transaction Bundle processing creates response locations but does not persist the resources.
currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.requiredFix: Implement real create, update, delete, conditional, transaction and batch behavior or remove unsupported claims.
acceptanceTests: Valid transaction Bundle is committed atomically
Response status and location match actual resources
Conditional and version operations behave correctly

currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.finding: The CapabilityStatement advertises interactions and operations that are not fully implemented.
currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.requiredFix: Generate capabilities from implemented behavior and remove unsupported operations.
acceptanceTests: Every advertised interaction has an endpoint test
Every advertised operation executes successfully or is removed

currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.finding: The IPS summary does not assemble complete clinical sections from persisted data.
currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.requiredFix: Aggregate authorized allergies, medications, conditions, observations, procedures, immunizations and supporting documents.
acceptanceTests: No cross-facility record enters the bundle
Generated bundle validates against selected IPS profile

currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.finding: HL7 V2 ingestion acknowledges messages without clearly applying supported message content.
currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.requiredFix: Implement message-type-specific mapping or clearly limit the public contract to parse-and-acknowledge behavior.
acceptanceTests: ADT creates or updates the correct visit state
ORM creates or updates the correct order
ORU creates or updates the correct result
DFT creates or reverses the correct financial event
Duplicate MSH-10 does not apply twice
Malformed messages return AE and quarantine safely

currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.finding: DICOM STOW is a metadata save and is not a real DICOM object store.
currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.requiredFix: Integrate a real PACS or implement standards-compatible multipart STOW/WADO/QIDO behavior.
acceptanceTests: WADO returns a retrievable DICOM object
PACS outage is handled and observable

currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.finding: mCSD Organization and Location endpoints return hardcoded sample resources.
currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.requiredFix: Replace hardcoded resources with persisted facility and location directory data.
acceptanceTests: Create, update and search behavior is tested

currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.finding: Missing practitioner credential records are treated as active.
currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.requiredFix: Fail closed for clinical actions. Keep any development bypass explicitly disabled in production.
acceptanceTests: Cross-facility credential does not permit access

currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.finding: Order safety checks receive empty medication, allergy and condition context in some REST flows.
currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.requiredFix: Load current authorized patient context or block the order with a documented missing-data reason.
acceptanceTests: Missing context produces a safe fail

currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.finding: eMAR barcode validation compares scanned text to a patient UUID string.
currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.requiredFix: Implement real patient wristband and medication barcode verification against the order.
acceptanceTests: Wrong time or duplicate administration is handled
Two-person rules are enforced where required

currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.finding: Billing posts one ledger entry and account balance rather than a fully reconciled journal model.
currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.requiredFix: Implement balanced, currency-safe, idempotent and reversible journal postings.
acceptanceTests: Duplicate posting is ignored or rejected
Refund and reversal balance the original transaction
Reconciliation report can explain every account movement

currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.finding: FEFO dispensing may oversell stock during concurrent requests.
currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.requiredFix: Use conditional database decrement or pessimistic locking and prevent negative inventory.
acceptanceTests: Expired and quarantined lots are excluded

currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.finding: Drafts and tenant AI flags are stored in process memory.
currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.requiredFix: Persist drafts, tenant policy, attestation and audit state to durable, tenant-scoped storage.
acceptanceTests: Draft status is consistent across pods
Audit persistence failure is handled safely

currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.finding: Regex redaction is not reliable for every direct or indirect identifier.
currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.requiredFix: Define redaction as a risk-reduction control, not guaranteed Safe Harbor compliance. Review and test before external AI use.
acceptanceTests: Known names and identifiers are removed
Common date, address and phone formats are removed
Adversarial and malformed input is tested
Redaction maps are protected and purgeable

currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.finding: Development and runtime code contains hardcoded secret values.
currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.requiredFix: Move all secrets to environment or secret-manager configuration and fail startup if required production secrets are missing.
acceptanceTests: Production startup fails without required secrets
Default credentials cannot reach production profile

currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.finding: Some governance audit failures are swallowed.
currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.requiredFix: Make mandatory audit failures block or durably queue the operation.
acceptanceTests: Mandatory event is not silently lost
Queue or fail-close behavior is demonstrated

currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.finding: The repository may not currently build or pass all database tests.
currentKnownP0AndP1Gaps.requiredFix: Run and repair the full build, migrations and test suite in CI.
acceptanceTests: Clean database migration passes on PostgreSQL
Clean database migration passes on SQL Server
Clean database migration passes on MySQL

phases.name: Security, build and platform foundation
phases.durationGuidance: First gate; no Phase 2 clinical deployment
deliverables: Maven reactor builds on clean environment
exitCriteria: Reference application can start from documentation

phases.name: Standards-based interoperability
exitCriteria: No hardcoded directory or protocol success

phases.name: Governed clinical AI
safetyRules: No direct patient release without approval
Every external model call uses approved credentials
All clinical AI has deterministic failure behavior

phases.name: Assurance and go-live
phases.releaseGate: No production release until P0 and P1 findings are closed and evidence is attached to the release.

testingRequirements.minimumCoveragePolicy: No module is complete because a percentage threshold was met. Critical authorization, merge, medication, billing, audit, transaction, and concurrency paths require explicit branch and integration tests.

agentExecutionInstructions.firstStep: Inspect the current code and compare every advertised claim with implementation. Do not assume previous README statements are correct.
agentExecutionInstructions.secondStep: Create an implementation backlog from the P0 and P1 gaps in this document.
agentExecutionInstructions.thirdStep: For every change, identify exact files, database migrations, API contracts, authorization checks, audit events and tests.
agentExecutionInstructions.fourthStep: Implement the smallest complete vertical slice before expanding to another module.
deliveryFormat: Do not mark a task complete without evidence

cannotBeProductionReadyUntil: P1 gaps are either closed or documented and blocked
Privacy and secret controls are reviewed
releaseReadinessGate.legalAndCertificationNote: Certification and regulatory compliance depend on jurisdiction, intended use, quality-system processes and independent assessment. Source code and testing cannot by themselves claim certification.
